items.q: How much does it cost to ship a car?
items.a: It depends on distance, vehicle size, trailer type and season. Most trips cost between $0.50 and $1.00 per mile, with shorter routes on the higher end. Use the estimate form for your route.
Pickup is usually within 1 to 5 days of your ready date. Once picked up, short routes take 1 to 3 days and cross-country routes take 7 to 10 days.
Open trailers are the most common and affordable option and work for most cars. Enclosed trailers protect classic, luxury and exotic cars from weather and road debris, and cost about 40% more.

items.q: Can you ship a car that doesn't run?
items.a: Yes. We arrange carriers with a winch for inoperable vehicles. Just let us know in the form so we can plan the right truck.

items.q: Is my car insured during transport?
items.a: Yes. Every carrier we work with carries cargo insurance. We verify their authority and insurance before assigning your vehicle.

items.q: Do I need to be there at pickup and delivery?
items.a: You or someone you trust (18+) needs to hand over the keys and sign the inspection report at pickup and delivery.
